correctness.rationale: For every a,b>=3 the categorical adjacency is (J_a−I_a)⊗(J_b−I_b), so the graph Laplacian splits into constant, first-coordinate, second-coordinate and tensor-interaction eigenspaces with eigenvalues 0,a(b−1),b(a−1),ab−a−b. The explicit source-sink mean-zero electrical potential is obtained by inversion of these nonzero eigenvalues. Its nine vertex levels have the coarea boundary sizes C1..C4 and their four mirror counterparts; inserting the verified order inequalities p>=q, p<2q,2p+q<1 for a>=b yields the exact symmetric B+R transfer-current column sum. Edge transitivity makes this the Q endpoint norm. Diagonal effective resistance 2(ab−1)/[ab(a−1)(b−1)] supplies the I−Q norm. Substituting a=u+3,b=a+v gives a manifestly positive coefficient polynomial for the strict global Q<8/3 inequality, and b→infinity with a=3 approaches 8/3; the companion P<11/3 bound and limits follow. Independent exact-rational grounded Laplacian inversion and edge-current summation reproduced (a,b)=(3,3),(3,4),(4,4),(3,5),(5,3),(4,6), and both Q/P rational values, without trusting the source checker.
